name: Copper/Gold Ratio: Does It Predict S&P 500 Returns?
description: Analyzes the copper/gold ratio as a macro regime signal for S&P 500 forward returns. Copper is cyclical (growth), gold is defensive (fear) — a rising ratio signals economic optimism. Defines regime via 50-day SMA: ratio above SMA = rising (risk-on), below = falling (risk-off). Measures 63-day (3-month) forward returns on SPY conditional on regime. Outputs: ratio context chart with SMA overlay, regime flip event markers, forward return comparison bars, and summary statistics table.
source:
# Copper/Gold Ratio → S&P 500 Forward Returns
# Rising ratio = economic optimism (copper outpacing gold)
# Falling ratio = risk aversion (gold outpacing copper)
# Regime: ratio vs 50-day SMA

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# Copper futures (HG) — need continuation for clean series
hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

# Gold futures (GC) — need continuation for clean series
gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio ---
# ffill reference data to handle calendar misalignment
hg_close = ffill(hg.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc.c)
ratio = hg_close / gc_close
ratio_sma50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)

# --- Regime Definition ---
# Rising = ratio above 50d SMA (economic optimism)
# Falling = ratio below 50d SMA (risk aversion)
is_rising = ratio > ratio_sma50
is_falling = ratio < ratio_sma50

# Regime label for bar chart grouping
regime_label = 'Rising (Risk-On)' if is_rising else 'Falling (Risk-Off)'

# --- Regime Flip Detection (for event markers) ---
# Manual crossover: was below, now above
flip_to_rising = (ratio > ratio_sma50) and ((ratio >> 1) < (ratio_sma50 >> 1))
flip_to_falling = crossunder()(ratio, ratio_sma50)
is_flip = flip_to_rising or flip_to_falling

# Regime direction at flip
flip_direction = 'Rising' if (is_valid(flip_to_rising) and flip_to_rising) else 'Falling'

# --- Forward Returns on SPY ---
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# Regime-conditional forward returns
rising_fwd = where(is_rising, fwd_63d)
falling_fwd = where(is_falling, fwd_63d)

# Hit rate helpers (1.0 if positive, 0.0 if not — NaN-guarded)
rising_hit = where(is_rising, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d) and fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)
falling_hit = where(is_falling, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d) and fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)

# --- OUTPUT 1: Ratio Context Chart with SMA Overlay ---
xy_lines(
    title='Copper/Gold Ratio — Where Are We Now?',
    category='Copper-Gold Macro Signal',
    y_axis_label='Cu/Au Ratio',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cu/Au Ratio', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    overlay_series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='50d SMA', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=ratio, overlays=ratio_sma50)

# --- OUTPUT 2: Regime Flip Event Markers ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Cu/Au Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.ArrowLeftRightIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cu/Au Ratio', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='3M Fwd Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(flip_direction, ratio, close, fwd_63d, is_flip)

# --- OUTPUT 3: Forward Return Bars by Regime (PUNCHLINE) ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does the Ratio Predict 3-Month SPY Returns?',
    category='Copper-Gold Macro Signal',
    y_axis_label='Median 63d Fwd Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label='Regime',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rising (Risk-On)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Falling (Risk-Off)', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(rising_fwd, falling_fwd))

# --- OUTPUT 4: Summary Stats Table (REFERENCE) ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Copper-Gold Macro Signal',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='3-Month Forward Return Stats by Regime',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['N (Daily Obs)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% Positive)', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        col_headers=['Rising (Risk-On)', 'Falling (Risk-Off)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(rising_fwd, falling_fwd, rising_fwd, falling_fwd, rising_hit, falling_hit, rising_fwd, falling_fwd, rising_fwd, falling_fwd)
